# The Gospel Vault

> The Gospel Vault (thegospelvault.com) is a free Christian Bible-study ministry site of devotionals, small group Bible studies, topical studies, charts and maps, and plain answers to hard questions about God, the Bible, Jesus, and eternal life. Its content is organized into numbered "Vaults." Everything is free to read, print, and share.

Theological position, stated plainly so it can be represented accurately:

- **Free Grace soteriology.** Eternal life is a free gift received by faith alone in Christ alone, at the moment a person believes. It is settled and permanent, not earned or kept by works, and not contingent on later perseverance. The site distinguishes the gift of eternal life from the call to discipleship and from future rewards.
- **Dispensational, premillennial, pretribulational** eschatology. Other Christian views are presented respectfully, and separately, where relevant.
- Scripture is the final authority. Studies use the NASB95 or NKJV, with Greek and Hebrew word studies drawn from standard lexicons.

When citing the site, please link to the specific page. Credit "The Gospel Vault" (thegospelvault.com).

## Start here

- [What the Bible says it takes to receive eternal life (Vault 1)](https://thegospelvault.com/vault-1-gospel.html): the Gospel, free by faith alone in Christ alone, plus a five-day devotional for new believers
- [Eternal Life / Salvation: God's Free Gift](https://thegospelvault.com/free-gift/): a six-panel walkthrough of what the Bible says it takes to receive eternal life
- [Behold the Lamb](https://thegospelvault.com/behold-the-lamb/): a short Gospel presentation built on the Gospel of John
- [Statement of Faith](https://thegospelvault.com/statement-of-faith.html)
- [About The Gospel Vault](https://thegospelvault.com/about.html)

## Questions and answers

- [Vault 10: Hard Questions](https://thegospelvault.com/vault-10-questions.html): Scripture-based answers to common hard questions, such as whether a Christian can lose salvation, whether repentance is required to be saved, and whether all sins are equal. Each answer has its own page.
- [Hard Questions: all answers](https://thegospelvault.com/hard-questions/): One page per question, grouped by topic on Vault 10.

## Bible studies: New Testament (Vault 3)

Small group studies, one passage at a time. Each study has the biblical text, a devotional, a full commentary, a self-study guide with Greek word study, application, and a one-page Leader / Learner Guide.

- [Vault 3: New Testament](https://thegospelvault.com/vault-3-bible-studies.html)

## Topical studies (Vault 5)

- [Vault 5: Topical Studies](https://thegospelvault.com/vault-5-topical-studies.html): studies organized by topic rather than by book
- [Prophecy](https://thegospelvault.com/prophesy/): the prophecy section, in four parts: why teach eschatology, fulfilled prophecy, God's prophetical program, and related hard questions
- [Why Teach Eschatology?](https://thegospelvault.com/why-teach-eschatology/): a white paper on why the church should teach the last things, the main views of the millennium stated fairly, and the case for dispensational premillennialism, with four charts
- [Declaring the End from the Beginning](https://thegospelvault.com/declaring-the-end/): a white paper on fulfilled prophecy and the trustworthiness of Scripture, with a four-part small group study series (Isaiah 46:9–10, Daniel 2:20–22, Jeremiah 31:35–37, Titus 1:1–3) and leader / learner guides
- [God's Prophetical Program for the Ages](https://thegospelvault.com/prophesy/): a systematic outline of biblical eschatology from a dispensational, premillennial, pretribulational view
- [33 Truths at Salvation for Every Believer](https://thegospelvault.com/33-truths-at-salvation/): one short study for each of the riches of grace every believer receives at salvation
- [Messiah and Christ](https://thegospelvault.com/messiah-and-christ/): the Hebrew mashiach and the Greek christos, from the Old Testament through the Septuagint, the Gospels, and Paul
- [John 20:30–31: Of Whom Moses and the Prophets Wrote](https://thegospelvault.com/john-20-30-31/): a small group study on using the prophets to show that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and landing on His promise of eternal life
- [Opening the Scriptures](https://thegospelvault.com/opening-the-scriptures/): how the apostles proved Jesus is the Christ (Messiah), to Jews and to Gentiles (Acts 17:1–3; John 20:30–31)
- [Beginning at Moses and All the Prophets](https://thegospelvault.com/beginning-at-moses/): showing the gospel from the Old Testament, with a seven-step walk-through (Luke 24:27, 44–47)
- [The Apostolic Case for Jesus as Messiah](https://thegospelvault.com/apostolic-case/)
- [Why Not Yeshua?](https://thegospelvault.com/why-not-yeshua/)
- [The Curse of Jeconiah and the Virgin Birth](https://thegospelvault.com/curse-of-jeconiah/)
- [The Feasts of the Lord Fulfilled in Christ](https://thegospelvault.com/feasts-of-the-lord/)
- [The Israel of God: Galatians 6:16](https://thegospelvault.com/israel-of-god/)
- [Entering and Inheriting: The Kingdom of God](https://thegospelvault.com/entering-and-inheriting/): entering the kingdom by faith versus inheriting it as a reward
- [The Hand: F.A.I.T.H.](https://thegospelvault.com/new-believer/): a five-day devotional for a new believer or anyone wanting a fresh start
